narrative: 有人在展示自己：一场演讲、一个舞台喜剧演员、一位必须完全对镜头开放的明星。朝向摄影机的那一侧脸承担曝光，所以那侧脸颊上的毛孔和表情都很容易被看清。
对于威胁感、隐秘感，或想让宽脸显瘦的人像来说，它就不是合适的工具。宽面光（Broad Lighting）不等于高调布光（High-Key Lighting）；房间依然可以是暗的。
它的定义只在于：哪一侧脸靠近镜头并被照亮。
how: 转动脸部，或把主光摆到能让朝向摄影机的那侧脸颊接受主光的位置，通常与近正面轴线呈30到45度角。补光可以给得慷慨一些。
硬度通常比黑色电影式的窄面光（Short Lighting）更柔和。色温则取决于公共空间本身：日光、影棚钨丝灯，或明亮的实景光源。
提示词：Broad lighting on [Subject], the camera-facing side keyed, open and public, less shadow on the near cheek.
when: 用于开放、易读的人像：公众人物，或喜剧特写。当靠近镜头的那侧脸颊本该是秘密时，就不要用它。
vs: 窄面光正好相反：远侧脸颊受光，近侧脸颊在暗部。高调布光是整体反差，常与宽面光搭配，但两者不是同一回事。
蝴蝶光（Butterfly Lighting）是正轴布光，不偏向任何一侧脸颊。环形光（Loop Lighting）可以根据头部转动角度，拍成宽面或窄面。
examples_film: 古典人像摄影和影棚喜剧特写——包括《罗马假日》（Roman Holiday）和《雨中曲》（Singin' in the Rain）中那些开放的脸——都把主光打在靠近镜头的脸颊上，让观众能拥有这个人。如果有阴影，也留在远侧。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是窄面光。破绽是近侧脸颊发暗，而远侧只有一线亮光。
解决办法是把主光转到朝向摄影机的一侧，或者把脸转向主光。

faq.q: 电影中的宽面光是什么？
faq.a: 照亮朝向摄影机那一侧脸的布光方式。靠近镜头的脸颊明亮，阴影则落在更远的一侧。

faq.q: 宽面光和窄面光有什么区别？
faq.a: 宽面光照亮近侧脸颊，感觉开放。窄面光照亮远侧脸颊，把神秘感留在朝向镜头的一侧。
当一张脸应该显得公开、易于解读时使用。如果想要雕塑感和保留信息，就不要用它。

faq.q: AI 图像或视频中如何提示宽面光？
faq.a: 指明朝向摄影机的一侧受光，近侧脸颊开放，最靠近镜头的那一面阴影更少。

narrative: Someone is presenting themselves: a speech, a studio comic, a star who must be fully available to the lens. The camera-facing plane carries the exposure, so pores and expression on that cheek are easy to read.
It is the wrong tool for menace, secrecy, or a slimming portrait on a wide face. Broad is not high-key; you can still have a dark room.
The definition is only which cheek is near and lit.
how: Turn the face or swing the key so the camera-facing cheek takes the key, often 30 to 45 degrees off a near-frontal axis. Fill can be generous.
Hardness is often softer than noir short lighting. Color is whatever the public space is: daylight, studio tungsten, a bright practical.
Prompt: Broad lighting on [Subject], the camera-facing side keyed, open and public, less shadow on the near cheek.
when: Use it for an open, readable portrait, a public figure, a comic close-up. Do not use it when the near cheek should be the secret.
vs: Short lighting is the reverse: far cheek keyed, near cheek dark. High-key lighting is overall contrast, which often pairs with broad but is not the same job.
Butterfly lighting is on-axis, so neither cheek is favored. Loop lighting can be executed broad or short depending on head turn.
examples_film: Classical portraiture and studio comedy close-ups, including open faces in Roman Holiday and Singin' in the Rain, key the near cheek so the public can have the person. The shadow, if any, lives on the far side.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is short lighting. The tell is a dark near cheek and a bright far sliver.
Fix it by turning the key onto the camera-facing side or turning the face toward the key.

faq.q: What is broad lighting in film?
faq.a: Lighting the side of the face turned toward camera. The near cheek is bright; the shadow sits farther away.
Broad keys the near cheek and feels open. Short keys the far cheek and puts mystery on the camera side.

faq.q: When should I use broad lighting?
faq.a: Use it when a face should feel public and easy to read. Skip it when you want sculpture and withheld information.

faq.q: How do I prompt broad lighting for AI image or video?
faq.a: Specify the camera-facing side keyed, open near cheek, less shadow on the plane closest to camera.
